basis.governing_question: Why do property and health claims take too long to settle, and what claims operating model should Atlântico Seguros move to?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish where and why property and health claims lose time on the way to settlement.

gate.label: Diagnostic readout
gate.decision: Do the COO and Head of Claims accept the diagnosed causes of slow settlement?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the target claims operating model for property and health claims, and the roadmap to reach it.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Do the COO and Head of Claims approve the final report for the Board presentation?

workstreams.name: Claims flow mapping
workstreams.answers: Where do property and health claims wait, loop or change hands between intake and settlement?
activities: Map each step of property and health claims handling
Walk through live cases with the people who handle them
Review claims handling documents and procedures

workstreams.name: Staff and customer views
workstreams.answers: What do claims staff and customers experience as the main delays and frustrations in settlement?
activities: Interview the people who handle property and health claims
Interview customers whose claims were recently settled
Review customer satisfaction results on settled claims

workstreams.name: Motor program comparison
workstreams.answers: What did the 2024 motor lean program change, and why did it not reach property and health claims?
activities: Review documents on the 2024 lean program
Interview the people who ran the motor program
Compare motor and property and health handling data

workstreams.name: Settlement time and causes
workstreams.answers: How long do property and health claims take to settle, and which causes explain the delay?
activities: Measure time per step from operational claims data
Test candidate causes against case files and staff views
Rank the causes by the settlement time they account for

workstreams.name: Target model options
workstreams.answers: Which claims operating models could remove the diagnosed causes of delay in property and health claims?
activities: Define options for organizing property and health claims
Compare options against the diagnosed causes of delay
Prepare options and trade-offs for the workshop

workstreams.name: Detailed model design
workstreams.answers: How would the chosen model run for property and health claims: roles, process flow and decision rights?
activities: Detail roles, process flow and decision rights
Fit the design to the current claims IT system
Review the draft design with the people who handle claims

workstreams.name: Model test against criteria
workstreams.answers: Does the chosen model show it can shorten settlement time without lowering customer satisfaction?
activities: Estimate the settlement time effect from baseline data
Check customer impact against satisfaction baseline
Document risks to settlement time and satisfaction

workstreams.name: Transition roadmap
workstreams.answers: What steps, sequence and change actions move property and health claims from today's handling to the chosen model?
activities: Sequence the steps from today's handling to the model
Identify the change actions needed for claims staff
Prepare the roadmap section of the final report

deliverables.name: Step map of property and health claims handling
Wait, loop and handover points in claims flow
Customer satisfaction baseline on settled claims
Interview synthesis of staff and customer pain points
Motor lean program comparison for property and health
Settlement time by step for property and health claims
Diagnostic readout with ranked causes of delay
Claims operating model options with trade-offs
Detailed design of the claims operating model
Model test against settlement time and satisfaction
Final written report and board presentation

events.label: Kick-off
events.decision: Do the COO and Head of Claims confirm the scope, team and calendar?
agenda: Present the engagement objectives and scope for property and health claims
Align on the team, interview access and workplan
Confirm the steering calendar and the Board date of March 15, 2027

events.label: Workshop 1: first findings
events.purpose: Review first findings on claims handling
events.decision: Does the steering group confirm the delay points to carry into the causes ranking?
agenda: Present the step map and the wait, loop and handover points
Review the satisfaction baseline, interview synthesis and motor comparison
Confirm the delay points to carry into the causes ranking

events.label: Diagnostic readout
events.purpose: Close the Diagnostic phase on ranked causes
events.decision: Do the COO and Head of Claims accept the diagnosed causes of slow settlement?
agenda: Present settlement time by step for property and health claims
Review the ranked causes of delay in the diagnostic readout
Decide whether to accept the diagnosed causes of slow settlement

events.label: Workshop 2: model options
events.purpose: Review model options before detailed design
events.decision: Which operating model option should go into detailed design?
agenda: Present the claims operating model options and their trade-offs
Discuss the trade-offs against the settlement time and satisfaction criteria
Decide which option goes into detailed design

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Approve the final report ahead of the Board
events.decision: Do the COO and Head of Claims approve the final report for the Board presentation?
agenda: Present the detailed design and its test against the criteria
Review the transition roadmap and the final report
Decide whether to approve the report for the Board presentation

deadline.text: Recommendations presented to the Board on March 15, 2027

architect_notes: Length is an estimate (13 to 17 weeks) resting on the archetype's typical weeks, two claim lines and 19 weeks available.
Not covered by the phases: ASF, supervisor guidance on claims-handling response times. Confirm whether it is in scope.
No Measurement phase: the engagement is an assessment, so results against the settlement-time and satisfaction criteria are not tracked after launch.
